_owner: contracts/privacy.py (Python) and contracts/privacy.ts (browser mirror) — one file, both implementations
_source: research/privacy-harness-spec.md §4.2 (the 18 validated reference cases), translated into the frozen interface of this repo: levels cell|parent|city, reason codes ok|lt_30_cards|lt_3_merchants|top1_gt_75|multi|all_levels_failed (+ g4_differencing, thin_base, no_data).

_semantics.levels: cards(R) is a UNION count over the cell's relation; `merchants` is the cell's OWN partition and MUST sum to n_transactions.
_semantics.levels_key: the cascade keys are cell -> parent -> city; the reference's code/fives/tens map positionally onto cell/parent/city. A case with ONE level is evaluated with gate(cell, level=<that key>); a case with several is evaluated with cascade().
_semantics.reason: ok when released; the single failing code when exactly one gate fails; 'multi' when several fail (the `failures` array then names all of them); 'all_levels_failed' when no cascade level passes; 'no_data'/'thin_base' are pre-gate reasons decided before any level is walked.
_semantics.failures: union of failing codes across every evaluated level, deduplicated, canonical order lt_30_cards -> lt_3_merchants -> top1_gt_75 -> g4_differencing.
_semantics.trace_failures: per evaluated level, the failing codes in that same canonical order.
_semantics.exactness: maxShare is the string '3/4'. A float can never enter this file. 75.000000% passes; 75.000025% fails.
_semantics.ids: 'E1', 'E2', ... are opaque merchant ids. No name, street or venue is recorded anywhere.

_edits_vs_reference: Every case drops the reference's separately-declared `n_entities`: it is DERIVED from len(merchants), because F-08/F-12/F-13 declared more entities than they listed (reference invariant P-4 violated by the reference's own fixtures).
n_transactions is stated explicitly and equals sum(merchants.values()) in every case (the reference's per_entity sums already satisfied this; it is now checked).
The reference's per-entity card counts are carried as `merchant_cards`, which is what lets the conservative CARD-share leg of G3 (case F-11) be evaluated at all.
F-03 E1 cards 40 -> 36: 40 cards for 36 transactions is impossible.

F-05 n_cards 120 -> 100 and cards 75/20/15/10 -> 75/15/5/5: 120 distinct cards from 100 transactions is impossible, and 20 cards from 15 transactions likewise. The tested property (exactly 75/100 = 75.0% passes) is unchanged.

F-08/F-09 code-level cards 30/8/6 -> 32/8/4: per-merchant card sets must union to at least the cell's 44 cards, and a merchant cannot hold more cards than transactions. Failing property (volume share 80%) unchanged.

F-16 is labelled g4_differencing: the reference reported the failing residual as 'G3_SHARE' even when the residual failed on its entity count. The code now names the gate that actually failed, with the sub-gates in `detail`.

cases.title: fails at every level -> all_levels_failed, level locked, full trace recorded

volume share passes (70%) but CARD share fails (76%) -> FAIL under the conservative rule

expect.note: the volume leg passes; the card leg fails; either exceeding the limit fails the cell (compliance §2.3 R7)
one part in four million above the limit. A float comparison is not guaranteed to keep F-12 and F-13 apart.

cases.title: non-additive children: the parent UNION has 30 cards while the children sum to 45 -> the union is authoritative

expect.note: an implementation that SUMS child card counts obtains 45 and would gate a different cell than the one it releases

differencing (G4): the cell passes G1-G3 but every residual after removing one merchant has 2 merchants

cases.title: thin_base is distinct from the privacy gates: 5 transactions -> thin_base, not lt_30_cards

expect_without_thin_base.note: the same cell with the display floor disabled is suppressed by the PRIVACY gates, which is why the two reasons must never be conflated in the UI

cases.title: empty relation -> no_data, level locked, value null, no trace (an empty cell is never a pass)

cascade_cases.title: fails at the cell level but passes at the parent level -> the PARENT value, level='parent', escalated=true

g4_cases.title: G4: the raw cell passes G1-G3, but removing the largest merchant leaves 20 cards -> suppressed

expect.note: the merchant knows its own 500 transactions, subtracts them from the released cell, and holds a 20-card residual. G1-G3 alone cannot see this.

expect_without_differencing.note: the control: the same cell IS released when G4 is off, which is what makes this test about G4 and not about the three gates

g4_cases.title: G4 literal case: a two-merchant cell cannot be released however large it is
G4 bound mode: no measured residual supplied -> the sound lower bound is used and reported

expect.note: 40 - 500 < 30, so the bound alone forces suppression; the trace says the evidence was a bound, not a measurement
